correctness.rationale: The candidate function is verified symbolically: each zero vertex has an explicit moving neighbor whose transfer remains Italian. Weight below three is impossible, and a complete weight-three case split proves uniqueness. The leaf transfer invoked by the published proof is Italian but not secure. Exhaustive computation independently checks the target and every smaller simple graph with a leaf.
